visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-opening hero: H1, subheading and CTA buttons beside a collage of images

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: (1) H1, subheading paragraph, CTA links each in its own paragraph; (2) two to four images (collage)
contentPattern.description: H1 + subheading + 'See case'/'All stories' buttons beside a 3-image collage grid — Fixed side-by-side layout: text/CTA column next to an image collage column; does not wrap as a list
contentPattern.notes: rc1: col1 H1+subheading+2 links, col2 3 images; rc2: col1 image, col2 breadcrumb links, H2, byline paragraphs

usage: Top-of-page intro where a headline and CTAs sit beside multiple photos.
reuseGuidance: Use for text + multi-image collage layouts. For a single image beside text use columns-article-intro or columns.
